guide.summary: An edge that is either Open or Closed.
guide.biology: A sluice or valve between two tanks either lets water through or stops it.
guide.rules: A shutter gate sits on the edge between two cells and is Open or Closed. Open, it is no barrier at all: everything crosses as if the edge were empty. Closed, it blocks everything: dissolved things, activities, viruses, organisms, deposits and warmth. It cannot sit on the rim of the dish. A dish holds at most 512 edge barriers, and two barriers on one edge are refused. No additional modeled reaction.
guide.example: Close a shutter in a wall between two groups, let each side settle, then open it and watch them meet.
